name: Thick Yeti Hide
summary: In Feralas, yeti hides draw the attention of leatherworkers who prize fine materials. Pratt McGrubben and Jangdor Swiftstrider seek them for their work.

sections.title: A Leatherworker’s Mark
sections.body: Feralas yetis are prized by two leatherworkers for their thick hides. Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold and Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache each ask for ten. They promise a choice of their leather goods in return. Both believe careful tanning can make these hides remarkably resilient.

faq.q: Where do thick yeti hides come from?
faq.answer: Thick Yeti Hides come from yetis in Feralas. Many are found in Feral Scar Vale, just inland from the Forgotten Coast.
Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold and Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache each seek ten Thick Yeti Hides.

faq.q: What are the hides used for?
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben and Jangdor Swiftstrider want the hides for their leatherworking. They believe skilled tanning can make them exceptionally resilient.
Each leatherworker offers a choice of crafted leather goods for a stack of ten Thick Yeti Hides.

angles.text: As a leatherworker, you may appreciate why Pratt McGrubben and Jangdor Swiftstrider prize hides they believe can be treated to remarkable strength.
